keyPoints.en: Batik (wax, canting or block), songket (gold/silver thread), labu sayong (clay, Perak), wau (bamboo and paper, Kelantan), ukiran kayu, anyaman, tekat.
keyPoints.bm: Batik (lilin, canting atau blok), songket (benang emas/perak), labu sayong (tanah liat, Perak), wau (buluh dan kertas, Kelantan), ukiran kayu, anyaman, tekat.

keyPoints.en: Motifs often come from plants (flora) and geometry.
keyPoints.bm: Motif sering diambil daripada tumbuhan (flora) dan geometri.

keyPoints.en: Syed Ahmad Jamal (abstract, National Artist), Abdul Latiff Mohidin (Pago-Pago), Chuah Thean Teng (batik painting), Ibrahim Hussein (printage), Abdullah Ariff (watercolour).
keyPoints.bm: Syed Ahmad Jamal (abstrak, Seniman Negara), Abdul Latiff Mohidin (Pago-Pago), Chuah Thean Teng (lukisan batik), Ibrahim Hussein (printage), Abdullah Ariff (cat air).

tip.en: Link each artist to one keyword.
tip.bm: Kaitkan setiap pelukis dengan satu kata kunci.

keyPoints.en: Feldman: description (what you see) → analysis (elements and principles) → interpretation (meaning) → judgement (reasoned opinion).
keyPoints.bm: Feldman: huraian (apa yang dilihat) → analisis (unsur dan prinsip) → interpretasi (makna) → penilaian (pendapat beralasan).
